title: Look At Player Behavior
description: Compels an entity to look at the player by rotating the `head` bone pose within a set limit.

angle_of_view_horizontal.title: Angle Of View Horizontal
angle_of_view_horizontal.description:
The angle in degrees that the mob can see in the Y-axis (up-down).

Sample values:
• ravager: 45

angle_of_view_vertical.title: Angle Of View Vertical
angle_of_view_vertical.description: The angle in degrees that the mob can see in the X-axis (left-right).

look_distance.title: Look Distance
look_distance.description:
The distance in blocks from which the entity will look at the nearest player.

Sample values:
• bogged: 8
• breeze: 16
• cave_spider: 6

look_time.title: Look Time
look_time.description:
Time range to look at the nearest player.

Sample values:
• zombie_horse: [2,4]
• campghost: [0,100]

probability.title: Probability
probability.description:
The probability of looking at the target. A value of 1.00 is 100%.

Sample values:
• allay: 0.02
• elder_guardian: 0.01
• enderman: 8

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
